**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event.impl.ui` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UIInputEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/impl/ui/UIInputEvent.java)

The base class of the input events of a UI, which a listener consumes to stop the input.

## Description

The `handleX` listeners of a UI receive an input after its nodes, and only when no node consumed it.
The nodes and the UI share the same input: the event of the UI is the source of the events of its nodes.

- [Events](/use/learn/interactivity/events/#follow-an-input-through-the-tree)

## Method details

<a id="UIInputEvent-method-consume"></a>

### consume

`void consume()` 

Stops the input: no other listener except the `MONITOR` ones, no UI below and not the host application receive it.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` in a `MONITOR` listener.

<a id="UIInputEvent-method-isConsumed"></a>

### isConsumed

`boolean isConsumed()` 

If `true`, a node or a listener consumed the input.
